name: __SLUG__ (checks + deploy)

# __NAME__'s own pipeline: lint, build, unit tests, rules tests against the
# emulators, then functions + rules + indexes + storage to __PROJECT__ on
# main. Hosting is the site workflow's job. On eject this file becomes the new
# repo's ci.yml with the apps/__SLUG__/ prefixes removed.

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "apps/__SLUG__/**"
      - ".github/workflows/app-__SLUG__.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "apps/__SLUG__/**"
      - ".github/workflows/app-__SLUG__.yml"
  workflow_dispatch: {}

concurrency:
  group: app-__SLUG__
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/__SLUG__
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"
      - name: Install deps
        run: npm ci && npm ci --prefix app && npm ci --prefix functions
      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint
      - name: Build
        run: npm run build
        env:
          VITE_FIREBASE_API_KEY: ${{ vars.__ENV___FIREBASE_API_KEY }}
          VITE_FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN: ${{ vars.__ENV___FIREBASE_AUTH_DOMAIN }}
          VITE_FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.__ENV___FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID }}
          VITE_FIREBASE_APP_ID: ${{ vars.__ENV___FIREBASE_APP_ID }}
      - name: Unit tests
        run: npm run test:run
      - name: Rules tests
        run: npm run test:rules

  deploy:
    needs: check
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' && vars.FIREBASE_DEPLOY_ENABLED == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: apps/__SLUG__
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - name: Install functions deps
        run: npm ci --prefix functions
      - uses: google-github-actions/auth@v2
        with:
          credentials_json: ${{ secrets.FIREBASE_SA_FAMILY_HUB }}
      - name: Deploy rules + indexes + storage
        run: npx firebase-tools@15 deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,storage --project __PROJECT__ --non-interactive
      - name: Deploy functions
        run: npx firebase-tools@15 deploy --only functions --project __PROJECT__ --non-interactive --force

      # Feedback loop, last step: any Feedback-Id trailer in the pushed commits
      # marks that report shipped, which is what tells the reporter it is live.
      - name: Mark feedback shipped
        if: ${{ !cancelled() && github.event_name == 'push' }}
        env:
          CI_FEEDBACK_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CI_FEEDBACK_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$CI_FEEDBACK_TOKEN" ]; then echo "CI_FEEDBACK_TOKEN not set; skipping"; exit 0; fi
          IDS=$(git log --format=%B ${{ github.event.before }}..${{ github.sha }} | grep -E '^Feedback-Id:' | sed -E 's/^Feedback-Id:[[:space:]]*//' | sort -u | tr -d '\r')
          if [ -z "$IDS" ]; then echo "no Feedback-Id trailers"; exit 0; fi
          BODY=$(printf '%s\n' "$IDS" | node -e 'const ids=require("fs").readFileSync(0,"utf8").split("\n").filter(Boolean);process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({reportIds:ids,version:process.argv[1]}))' "${GITHUB_SHA::7}")
          curl -sS -f -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "x-ci-token: $CI_FEEDBACK_TOKEN" \
            --data "$BODY" https://us-central1-__PROJECT__.cloudfunctions.net/markFeedbackShipped || echo "::warning::markFeedbackShipped failed; reports stay open"
